title: [ORG]AIOC-PPD - release notice to the next stage
description: Sent to Delivery and Implementation on every filing of a decided PPD Release (blueprint §5.10, rule 5; Protocol §20, item 9). It points to the filed release and to the TOM Release it rests on; it never carries release text, atom text or the name of a person. notice_id is 'PPDN-' + the SHA-256 of the canonical notice without notice_id (keys sorted, separators ',' and ':', UTF-8).

tom_release.description: The decided TOM Release this PPD Release was designed from.

filed_ref.description: The filed copy of the PPD Release in Source Lifecycle, as the filing receipt names it.

final_status.description: Only a decided release is announced.

final_status_ref.description: The decision reference in Source Lifecycle.

answers.description: The returns of Delivery and Implementation this release answers (blueprint §5.11); may be empty.
